items.source:
Unless explicitly configured otherwise this factory will create servers that listen for
HTTP requests on port 8080.
items.translation: 除非显式配置为其他值，否则该工厂将创建在 8080 端口上监听 HTTP 请求的服务器。

items.source: Return a Jetty Configuration that will invoke the specified ServletContextInitializers. By default this method will return a ServletContextInitializerConfiguration.
items.translation: 返回一个 Jetty Configuration，它将调用指定的 ServletContextInitializers。默认情况下，此方法将返回一个 ServletContextInitializerConfiguration。

items.source: Factory method called to create the JettyWebServer. Subclasses can override this method to return a different JettyWebServer or apply additional processing to the Jetty server.
items.translation: 调用工厂方法创建JettyWebServer。子类可以重写此方法以返回不同的JettyWebServer，或对 Jetty 服务器应用额外的处理。
